dropzones.name: Športno letališče Ptuj (Moškanjci)
dropzones.status_evidence: Dated evidence is the yearly Ptuj parachuting cup at Moškanjci (45th on 17-18 Aug 2024; 46th on 14-15 Jun 2025, held with five teams) and tandems at the club open day on 6 Sep 2025. The club's Cessna 206 tandem offer has no dates, and an independent tandem pilot books Moškanjci only on request; no 2026 jump date was found. That is recurring club and event jumping, which this inventory classes as seasonal, not a regularly operating dropzone.
